between: museum-framework.md section 3.10, which specifies the Exclusion Note as the display form for a hypothesis gated out under Step 7 and rules that it "cannot be expanded into an exhibit without the gate result being overturned first"
and: 13-PRODUCT-ARCHITECTURE/prove-it-specification.md rules W-R1 and W-R2. W-R1 moves a gate-failed conclusion INTO the offered set, with the gate result standing, wherever the gate rests on something below the accepted threshold. W-R2 applies the Exclusion Note component to withheld conclusions that are not gated-out hypotheses at all - bridge-not-established, no-claim-of-required-kind, absence-not-of-usable-type.
what_disagrees: Whether a gated-out explanation may be surfaced to a visitor as an offerable conclusion, and whether the Exclusion Note component covers refusals that failed no gate. Section 3.10 reads as forbidding the first and is silent on the second.
measured: Not a measurement. Both passages read in full as committed on main: museum-framework.md section 3.10, and prove-it-specification.md sections 4.5 and 4.5.1.
severity: MEDIUM. No evidentiary claim is affected. It governs how a refused explanation is displayed, which is where both false equivalence and quiet suppression enter a product.
resolvable_here: PARTLY. The specification states the reading it works under: section 3.10 governs a gated-out hypothesis being given an EXHIBIT, and a conclusion offered to a visitor with its gate rendered against it is neither an exhibit nor an unqualified offer. Whether that is what section 3.10 intended is the framework author to say.
effect: W-R1 exists because the alternative is worse: refusing a visitor a conclusion on a gate the institution has not itself verified is the failure logged as BF-025. Reading section 3.10 to forbid W-R1 would reinstate that failure. The extension is declared rather than smuggled, which is the difference between this row and BF-022.
action: Referred to the museum framework for a scope note on section 3.10 saying whether the Exclusion Note rule is confined to exhibit expansion, and whether the component covers non-gate refusals. No register row is promoted or demoted. Queued as RA-024 alongside the section 8.5 finding.
